title: Keep stale inbox replies protected or silent
description: Correctness/security review of atomic context-ref migration: coap_server.c msg_inbox_post now calls protect_response_ref but on failure still invokes plaintext lichen_coap_respond 5.00. A context freed/rebound during application callback correctly yields CONTEXT_STALE then leaks an unprotected error path. Route fallback through shared send_protected with same captured ref/PIV or silent-drop; never reacquire context.
acceptance_criteria: Actual inbox callback invalidates context; no plaintext response sent, stale result propagates; normal protected replies still pass;3 final reviews clear.
close_reason: Reproduced plaintext fallback before fix. Actual inbox callback invalidation now yields CONTEXT_STALE and zero packets; normal Created response matches independently computed ciphertext.15/15 native_sim focused tests pass;3 independent final reviews clear.
